metadata.name: Guide: User Story Implementation
metadata.referencia: README.md and docs/guides/ of the FRAMAI repository; standards in .ai-vexarq/core/engineering-standards.xml

flujo_general.paso: Prepare the user story with clear acceptance criteria
Use the template according to scope (full-stack, backend-only, etc.)
Let the Orchestrator classify and route
Review the documentation generated in docs/ (user-stories, code-structure, implementation-report, integration-report)

requisitos_previos.requisito: Project with a code base (frontend and/or backend)
User story with explicit and verifiable acceptance criteria

templates_disponibles.template: User-story batch (epic) full-stack with Git, environment, containers, and real integration

troubleshooting.problema: Verify that an identifiable base project exists
Review the Orchestrator's complexity_rationale; correct manually if necessary
Run the Integrator; review the contract
V2 must correct them; do not declare COMPLETED
State in the prompt "Do not stop at analysis; produce verifiable changes" (included in the templates); an identifiable archetype or mockup is not BLOCKED
It is not a blocker: install it or use a container (policies.xml, comportamiento_ante_bloqueos)
Stop and report; never write credentials in the repository (git-workflow.xml)
Verify project_mode MOCKUP_PRODUCTIONIZATION in the plan and run its protocol (project-modes.xml)
